card.title: Coffee Consumption and Longevity: An Observational Cohort
card.methods: Observational cohort of 50,000 adults followed for 10 years. No intervention; associations only.
card.main_findings: Higher self-reported coffee intake was associated with lower all-cause mortality.
card.limitations: Observational design; cannot establish causation. Possible confounders (income, lifestyle).

ledger.claim: People who drank more coffee tended to live longer in this cohort.
ledger.source_evidence: Higher coffee intake was associated with lower all-cause mortality.

title_options: 每天喝咖啡，竟然能让你更长寿
draft.body: 好消息！最新研究证明，喝咖啡能让你活得更久。只要每天多喝几杯，咖啡就会延长你的寿命。
